**Type:** periodical

## Description

This was a periodical published by Rivington, which ran from 1866 to 1890.  It was edited by the Rev. [J. J. Halcombe](../people/person_604.qmd), editorial secretary to the SPCK.  It is not to be confused with the <i>Mission Field</i>, the organ of the SPG.  CMY commented (1 Jan 1872) on the details of Bishop Patteson's death provided by Charles Hyde Brooke’s account in <i>Mission Life</i>.
